description.value: Espresso Café appears to be a coffee shop offering espresso drinks, cold beverages, and a breakfast and bakery menu, based on page-title remnants visible in its sitemap. The domain has been taken over by an unrelated online gambling affiliate site, making current operational details unverifiable. The café's community is listed as Tsawwassen in OSM, though archived page titles reference 'Surrey Coffee.'

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a café in Tsawwassen with a website URL. The website content, however, has been fully taken over by an online casino affiliate operation — the front page and betting subpages contain no café information. The sitemap page retains ghostly page titles referencing 'Espresso Cafe – Surrey Coffee' and a coffee/food menu, indicating the domain once belonged to a café, but current content is entirely unrelated. A further discrepancy exists: the sitemap says 'Surrey Coffee' while the OSM node places the business in Tsawwassen, suggesting either a location mismatch or stale OSM data. No amenity evidence is derivable from the current website.
concerns: Website domain (espressocafe.ca) has been hijacked by an online casino/sports betting affiliate site — no café content is accessible.
Sitemap page-title remnants reference 'Espresso Cafe – Surrey Coffee', contradicting the OSM-assigned community of Tsawwassen; the physical location needs verification.
No address or phone number in OSM; impossible to independently verify the business location.
Cannot confirm current operating status of the café.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The registered domain has been taken over by a gambling affiliate site, making it impossible to confirm the café is still operating. A location discrepancy (OSM: Tsawwassen vs. sitemap remnants: Surrey) further casts doubt on the accuracy of this OSM node and warrants manual verification before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The sitemap ghost-titles suggest the café previously offered espresso drinks, cold creations, breakfast items (egg bagels, English muffins, wraps), and bakery goods. If the physical business is confirmed at a verifiable address, re-enrichment with a working contact URL would be worthwhile.
